-- Fetch all contacts (3 pages, 24 total)
local companies = {}
for _, c in ipairs(tool('list_companies', {})) do
  companies[c.domain] = c.name
end

local contacts = {}
local page = 1
repeat
  local r = tool('list_contacts', { page = page })
  for _, ct in ipairs(r.items) do contacts[#contacts + 1] = ct end
  page = page + 1
until page > r.total_pages

local function e164(phone)
  -- already valid? +1 followed by exactly 10 digits
  if phone:match('^%+1%d%d%d%d%d%d%d%d%d%d$') then return nil end
  local digits = phone:gsub('%D', '')
  if #digits == 11 and digits:sub(1,1) == '1' then
    digits = digits:sub(2)
  end
  if #digits == 10 then
    return '+1' .. digits
  end
  return nil -- unexpected; skip
end

local phones_fixed, companies_filled = 0, 0
local updates = {}
for _, ct in ipairs(contacts) do
  local upd = { id = ct.id }
  local changed = false
  local newphone = e164(ct.phone)
  if newphone and newphone ~= ct.phone then
    upd.phone = newphone
    changed = true
    phones_fixed = phones_fixed + 1
  end
  if ct.company == '' then
    local domain = ct.email:match('@(.+)$')
    local name = domain and companies[domain]
    if name then
      upd.company = name
      changed = true
      companies_filled = companies_filled + 1
    end
  end
  if changed then updates[#updates + 1] = upd end
end

for _, upd in ipairs(updates) do
  tool('update_contact', upd)
end

return { total_contacts = #contacts, phones_fixed = phones_fixed, companies_filled = companies_filled, updates = updates }
